title: Alumina
text: This remedy is characterized by a general sluggishness and lack of vital force. It is useful in cases of constipation and chronic inflammation of the mucous membranes. There is a general feeling of dryness and lack of secretions. The patient is often a thin, dry person. There is a marked tendency to paralysis and loss of control over the muscles. Confused and forgetful. Depression and anxiety. Fears that the mind will give way. Time passes too slowly. Headache, with a sensation of weight in the forehead. Vertigo. Scalp feels tight. Burning and itching of the eyelids. Dimness of vision. Double vision. Chronic catarrh of the nose. Dryness and obstruction. Sneezing. Expression of pain and anxiety. Pale and sallow. Sensation of a cobweb on the face. Dryness of the mouth. Tongue feels dry and sticky. Dryness and rawness in the throat. Sensation of a splinter in the throat. Constant desire to swallow. Hawking of mucus. Appetite poor. Thirst. Heaviness and pressure after eating. Craving for dry food. Distended with gas. Rumbling. Flatulence. Chronic constipation. Stool large, hard, and dry. Much straining, even with soft stool. Constipation. Anus feels dry and sore. Frequent desire to urinate. Scanty urine. Leucorrhoea, with a sensation of dryness. Menses scanty and delayed. Shortness of breath on motion. Violent cough, ending in sneezing. Stiffness and aching in the back. Sensitiveness of the spine to touch. Aching and lameness in the limbs. Heaviness in the legs. Trembling of the hands. Dry and scaly. Itching and burning. Eruptions like miliary rash. Worse in the morning and from dry food. Better from open air and moderate motion. Compare: Alumen; Baryta carbonica; Conium; Silicea. Third to thirtieth potency.
